 10 Florida Christmas parades, boat parades on Treasure Coast in 2026
 Valeria Bartra and Cheryl Smith, Treasure Coast Newspapers 2026년 11월 13일 금 오전 10:05 UTC 0 Christmas parades on land and boat parades on water abound on the Treasure Coast this December.
 Parade floats will wind through downtown streets, and boats festooned with Christmas decorations and blaring holiday music will fill waterways from the Indian River Lagoon to the St. Lucie River from Dec. 4-12.
 Advertisement
 Here's what you need to know about the 2026 Christmas parades and Christmas boat parades in Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties. They are listed in order of date and time, with parades first, followed by boat parades.
 CHRISTMAS PARADES
 Dec. 4: 65th annual Stuart Christmas Parade
 Start time:  7 p.m. 
 Parade route:  Starts at Smithfield Plaza on Southeast Monterey Road, heads west on Ocean Boulevard, ends at Southeast Georgia Avenue near Stuart Middle School; judge stand is just east of Hospital Road
 Theme: Santa’s Stuart Vacation
 Website:  stuartchristmasparade.com 
 Dec. 5: 40th annual Hobe Sound Christmas Parade
 Start time:  1 p.m. 
 Where:  Starts at Venus Street and Dixie Highway, heads north on A1A, then west on Bridge Road, then south on Hercules Avenue, ends at J.V. Reed Park, with the judges stand at the Hobe Sound Centre Building
 Theme: Florida Style Christmas
 Website:  hobesound.org/christmas-parade 
 Dec. 5: Indiantown Christmas Parade
 Start time:  5:45 p.m. 
 Parade route:  Starts at Big Mound Park on Indian Mound Drive, heads west on Yalaha Street, south on Jackson Avenue, west on Osceola Street, ends Post Family Park
 Website:  indiantownchamber.com 
 Dec. 5: Vero Beach Christmas Parade
 Santa photos: 3-5 p.m. at Sexton Plaza show stage on Ocean Drive
 Red carpet preshow: 5-5:45 p.m.
 Parade starts:  6 p.m. 
 Parade route:  Along Ocean Drive from Cardinal Drive north to Jaycee Park; judges stand at Sexton Plaza
 Website:  verobeachchristmasparade.org 
 Watch live: Facebook livestream 
 Dec. 5: Port St. Lucie Parade of Lights
 Festival starts: 2 p.m. with holiday DJ, contests, market, midway carnival
 Parade starts:  6 p.m. 
 Parade route:  Through and around MIDFLORIDA Credit Union Event Center grounds, 9221 S.E. Event Center Place
 Tree lighting: 7 p.m.
 Concert: 7:30 p.m. featuring  Greggie and the Jets , an Elton John tribute band
 Fireworks: 9 p.m. featuring Zambelli Fireworks
 Website :  cityofpsl.com 
 Dec. 5: Sebastian Christmas Parade
 Start time:  6:30 p.m. 
 Parade route:  Along Indian River Drive from the Main Street Boat Ramp to Riverview Park
 Website:  cityofsebastian.org 
 Dec. 6: 38th annual Sights & Sounds on Second Street
 Festival starts:  1 p.m. on Second Street between Avenue A and Orange Avenue
 Parade starts: 6 p.m.
 New parade route :  Tickle Tummy Hill (Second and A.E. Backus streets), east on Avenue A, south on Melody Lane, west on Orange Avenue and south to Citrus Avenue end
 Theme: “That’s a Wrap! Celebrating Milestones & Memories”
 Tree lighting and Holiday Lights Spectacular: Marina Square immediately after parade
 Website:  mainstreetfortpierce.org 
 CHRISTMAS BOAT PARADES
 Dec. 5: Martin County Christmas Boat Parade
 Start time:  6 p.m. 
 Parade route:  Starts at Sandsprit Park, heads to Manatee Pocket, passes downtown Stuart, ends at Roosevelt Bridge
 Website: miatc.org and Facebook 
 Dec. 6: Vero Beach Christmas Boat Parade
 Start time:  6 p.m. 
 Parade route:  Starts at Indian River Lagoon Light 139 just north of Merrill P. Barber Bridge, goes around Fritz Island, passes City Marina with judges stand at fuel dock, south past Farley Island, east at Riomar Day Beacon 1, loops back around at Quail Valley River Club, south to Vero Isles, west to shore for final northbound pass, ends at Royal Palm Pointe Park.
 Best viewing: City Marina, Riverside Park, Cole Coppola Memorial Fishing Pier, A.W. Young Park, Royal Palm Pointe Park
 Website:  miatc.org and covb.org 
 Dec. 12: 36th annual St. Lucie County Christmas Boat Parade
 Start time:  6 p.m. 
 Parade route:  Daybeacon 188 off Fort Pierce City Marina, south under South Bridge and back, east through Fort Pierce Inlet, ends at Jetty Park; judges stand at Pelican Yacht Club
 Best viewing: Jetty Park, Museum Pointe Park, South Causeway Cove Beach, Seaway Drive public areas and waterfront restaurants, including Chuck's Seafood, On the Edge, Manatee Island, Square Grouper
 Theme: Stars, Stripes & Christmas Lights
 Website : miatc.org and Facebook
